NTA Warns of Action Against Fake AI-Generated OMR Sheets in NEET

The National Testing Agency has warned of strict action against fake OMR sheets submitted for the NEET-UG result, amid concerns over AI-generated documents. The agency is scrutinizing several altered documents and may cancel results or debar candidates who submit them.
